hooks.name: After a task: sync docs, specs and journal
hooks.description: Keeps docs, specs and the Kiro write-up journal in sync with code as each spec task finishes.

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Before moving on: (1) make sure the matching checkbox in the spec's tasks.md is updated; (2) update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PRIVACY.md, docs/PERFORMANCE.md or docs/COMPATIBILITY.md if behavior changed; (3) add a short entry to docs/kiro-journal.md (what worked, what did not, IDE vs CLI notes); (4) confirm tests were added or updated (unit, property-based where pure logic exists) and that docs/SUBMISSION.md still reflects the Kiroween rules.
